subBlocks.label: title
subBlocks.content: Quotation & Proposal
The photographer provides a detailed quote and proposal for the project. Custom pricing packages sent via email, including deliverables and terms.

blocks.className: w-720px min-h-132px d-flex  p-10-8px  gap-10px journey1-container margin-left-120px  position-relative border-radius-24

subBlocks.label: title
subBlocks.content: Pre-Shoot Preparation
The photographer and client prepare for the session. Client receives a prep guide (e.g., outfits, location tips). Timeline or shot list planning based on client goals.

blocks.className: w-720px min-h-132px d-flex  p-10-8px  gap-10px journey1-container margin-left-120px  position-relative border-radius-24

subBlocks.label: title
subBlocks.content: Shoot Day Phase
The photographer captures the planned session. A welcoming, professional experience to make clients feel comfortable.

subBlocks.label: title
subBlocks.content: Wedding Film
You shall receive a 5-8 minute cinematic video curated from the best events, delivered within 60 days from payment clearance.

blocks.className: w-720px min-h-132px d-flex  p-10-8px  gap-10px journey1-container margin-left-120px  position-relative border-radius-24

subBlocks.label: title
subBlocks.content: Traditional Videos
You shall receive long traditional videos of all events in documentary style, delivered within 75 days from payment clearance.

blocks.className: w-720px min-h-132px d-flex  p-10-8px  gap-10px journey1-container margin-left-120px  position-relative border-radius-24

subBlocks.label: title
subBlocks.content: Post-Production Phase
Photos are edited, and final deliverables are prepared. Sneak peeks or teasers shared with the client (optional).

blocks.className: w-720px min-h-132px d-flex  p-10-8px  gap-10px journey1-container margin-left-120px  position-relative border-radius-24

subBlocks.label: title
subBlocks.content: All Event Photos
You Shall receive 1000-3000 fully edited images from all events delivered on the cloud within 60 days from payment clearance.

blocks.className: w-720px min-h-132px d-flex  p-10-8px  gap-10px journey1-container margin-left-120px  position-relative border-radius-24

subBlocks.label: title
subBlocks.content: HDD Delivery
We Will deliver your HDDs with long videos and all the rae data.

blocks.className: w-720px min-h-132px d-flex  p-10-8px  gap-10px journey1-container margin-left-120px  position-relative border-radius-24

subBlocks.label: title
subBlocks.content: Delivery
Final photos are delivered to the client. Online gallery, USB drive, or physical albums provided. Option for additional services like framing or prints.

blocks.className: w-720px min-h-132px d-flex  p-10-8px  gap-10px journey1-container margin-left-120px  position-relative border-radius-24

subBlocks.label: title
subBlocks.content: Feedback & Review
The photographer gathers client feedback and testimonials. Follow-up email with a request for a review or referral.

blocks.className: w-720px min-h-132px d-flex  p-10-8px  gap-10px journey1-container margin-left-120px  position-relative border-radius-24

subBlocks.label: title
subBlocks.content: Retention & Relationship Building

The client is encouraged to stay connected for future projects. Exclusive offers for repeat sessions. Sharing client photos on social media (with consent). Email newsletters or updates on seasonal promotions.
